text: This report requests that City Council deny the request for a permit to remove one privately owned silver maple tree located at 51 Walker Avenue. The application indicates the reason for removal is to accommodate the proposed construction of a swimming pool. The subject tree is a silver maple (Acer saccharinum), measuring 61 cm in diameter. The Tree By-laws do not support the removal of this tree as it is healthy and maintainable.
The Toronto and East York Community Council deferred consideration of the item until its September 9, 2021 meeting.
